The **Permissions** module in Sistent provides declarative authorization abstractions that integrate directly with `@meshery/schemas/permissions` and host ability evaluators.

1. Mounting PermissionProvider

 Mount `PermissionProvider` at the root of your application. Supply the authorization check function (`userHasPermission`) and the user's active session metadata (`userContext`).

Component API & Props

Base Component Permission Props

Components including Button, IconButton, MenuItem, ListItem, and ListItemButton accept the following props:

Prop Type Default Description
permissionKey PermissionKeySpec undefined Permission key or key set. When omitted, the component renders normally without gating.
permissionAction 'showShield' | 'hide' 'showShield' When unauthorized, 'showShield' attaches PermissionShield and 'hide' renders null.

PermissionShieldProps

Prop Type Default Description
permissionKey PermissionKeySpec required Single Key or composite anyOf / allOf key set.
children React.ReactNode required The affordance or child component to guard.
variant 'inline' | 'badge' 'inline' Visual placement of the shield trigger icon overlay.

PermissionSessionContextProps

Prop Type Default Description
variant 'tooltip' | 'card' 'tooltip' Visual theme and sizing variant (compact tooltip vs. full-page 403 card).
permissionKey PermissionKeySpec undefined Self-resolving key or key set. Resolves missing keys from nearest PermissionProvider.
displayedKeys Key[] undefined Pre-resolved array of permission keys to display.
subtitle string undefined Custom requirement subtitle (e.g. "Needs any of: ...").
categories string[] undefined Category chip labels.
subcategories string[] undefined Subcategory chip labels.

PermissionProviderProps

Prop Type Default Description
userHasPermission (key: Key) => boolean required Authorization evaluator function provided by the host application (e.g., CASL canKey).
userContext PermissionUserContext undefined Active session metadata containing userName, orgName, and roleNames.
children React.ReactNode required Root application sub-tree.
